full_judgment: 4. Defendant Nos. 11 and 13 contested the suit by filing separate written statement. The case of the defendant No. 11 is that Jabborullah was the C.S. recorded tenant of the suit property and he settled the property by way of pattan to Arman Mutaiat and after the death of Arman Mutatatil. Sonamuddin being the only heir possessed the suit property. The R.S. and S.A. Khatians were correctly prepared in the name of Sonamuddin. Sonamuddin sold .19 acre of land to defendant No. 11 and his brother by two separate sale deeds and accordingly they are in possession of said land and enjoying the land by constructing because thereon, and the other defendants as heirs of Sonamuddin have been in possession of the suit property and the plaintiffs have no right, title over the suit property. Defendant No. 13 in his written statement also denied the material allegations as made in the plaint and asserted that Jabborullah was the original recorded tenant of the suit property who transferred the property to Arman Mutaiat, Arman Mutaiat died leaving behind 4 sons, 1(one) daughter and wife who had been in possession of the land for long 76 years. The defendant No. 13 is the son of Arman Mutaiat but the property was wrongly recorded in the name of Sonamuddin, elder son of Arman. Sonamuddin fraudulently sold .19 acre of land to defendant No. 11 and the plaintiff instituted the suit on false assertions and as such the suit is liable to be dismissed.
